Docs.summary: Well-known keys for the cloud-specific metadata returned by .

remarks.para: Cloud metadata is returned as a string-keyed dictionary rather than as fixed typed properties, so that new cloud-specific values can be added — and obsolete ones removed — without source- or binary-breaking callers. Callers read values by these key constants.
These are MSAL's public keys. Higher-level SDKs that carry additional, internal-only cloud values define their own key namespace and translate to these keys before handing a value to MSAL.

Preferred network/cache hosts are deliberately not exposed here: MSAL's instance-discovery pipeline resolves them from its own internal table and never reads them from this dictionary, so a value placed here would be inert. To override preferred hosts, use (or the JSON overload) instead.

Docs.summary: The cloud-specific FIC (Federated Identity Credential) token-exchange audience URI, stored without the /.default suffix (e.g., "api://AzureADTokenExchange"). Use to obtain the scope form (with /.default) for client-credentials flows.
